alternative.aliasRationale: Source exposes provisional Dark appearance for the same concept. This is not a fourth concept or a later approved look. Explicit Dark query aliases the default, and selecting Dark removes the query.
alternative.meaning: A, At the fixture: a generic bring-up fixture built from seven socket/contact modules; opens from joined fixture to a command-to-observation arrangement, then reconnects. Personal fixture authorship grounds the recommendation; geometry is illustrative, not actual hardware. Provisional Dark rendering alias.
alternative.observationScope: Retain the real opposite-look starting route and both pointer/keyboard switch trials; no state forcing or assumed material-look pass.

1 / Purpose · Concept A
How do you connect a firmware decision to a physical observation?

Ada Mensah · Embedded firmware

I wrote the Mosslink firmware, scheduled its power states and built its bring-up fixture.

Email Ada
Read the evidence

Generic bring-up fixture; original explanatory geometry, not actual hardware.

2 / Observation · Concept A
Follow the observation

The modules open into a path from firmware command to bench observation. Bring-up checks a new board’s basic operation.

A current trace showed the radio remaining awake after a failed transmission. No cause, fix or later resolution is confirmed.

Two-year battery life: projection from bench currents and an assumed reporting cycle. Longest run: 72 hours. No field endurance or weather testing supports the projection.

Generic bring-up fixture; original explanatory geometry, not actual hardware.

3 / Handover · Concept A
A decision needs an observation

A firmware decision needs a physical observation. An estimate and an observed run support different claims.

Mosslink: forty engineering samples assembled; six bench-tested; none sent to customers. One preliminary emissions check passed; full qualification remains unfinished.
